label: Agent-guided discovery pilot: five Fourth Way targets blocked on retrieval and binder tags
summary: Agent-guided discovery pilot (#1832), the five targets other than eaa4c679 (attempt e63628f1). Runs, all at 495c8f19f on the six Fourth Way targets that #1826 left unresolved (64498e7e, 4c79298d, 6c27657f, a9622441, eaa4c679, 101bdd62), Duper only, pool all, 100k heartbeats: baseline without AI guidance, 8 candidates (the Phase A next-test rerun, report 20261122T143055Z; about 361 s of goal time for these six, inside a 966 s run): all six unresolved. G1, 24 candidates (report 20261122T150930Z; 595 s total run): five unresolved; GradesFoundInThings closed only from GradesByApproachToAMaximum with QuartaViaUnboundedDegrees, the recorded incompatible bundle of argument 4723de84, filtered as domain_by_name and senses. G2a, 8 candidates with a temporary whole-binder tag overlay over the 42 declarations of the targets and their known derivations (carriers Being/B/Entity and Respect/R with temporary senses; InAct/Has, MoreIn, CausesIn, esse/being, IsGod, PriorSimply with IN_ACT_4, MORE_1, CAUSE_2, the esse frame sense, GOD_4, PRIOR_1; report 20261122T150131Z; 328 s total run): all six unresolved; the overlay unified the retrieved binders, but the known premises were still not retrieved. Its three missing-bridge proposals (CausesIn c x r implies InAct c r; PriorSimply x y implies IsGod x; InAct x r implies IsGod x) repeat the #1826 candidates, far stronger than any recorded reading, and are not adopted. A G2b run (overlay, 24 candidates) was stopped while queued and has no result. Diagnosis (scripts/discover_blueprint.py diagnose with the binder export scripts/DiscoverBinders.lean): each target already has verified conditional derivations, and for each of them the run both failed to retrieve at least one premise and would have needed a binder identification that no tag records. Obligations: 101bdd62 needs Aristotle's AsToBeingSoToTruthReading binders Entity, Has, truth, being read as Being, InAct, verum, esse (5a948c37 was not retrieved even at 24 candidates); 4c79298d needs the GodMaximalCausal and PreexistenceWithoutTransfer carriers B, R with their IsGod, CausesIn, MoreIn, esse identified with StageTwo's; 6c27657f needs the CausesIn of ExceededPerfectionIsCaused, of InMetaphysicam's no-regress premise and of PreexistenceWithoutTransfer identified (Being/Respect match only by the flagged name fallback); 64498e7e has since gained the merged route f8ba2429 plus 634a80b8 (#1835, result 77485e04), not re-registered; a9622441's known route is the cogito route (Descartes lane, not pursued). Identification oracle (scripts/testdata/discover-blueprint/IdentificationOracle.lean, a manual check): with the identifications that the verified arguments 8542e377, 4d1efe91 and c201b61a already make by instantiation, Duper or a short hand proof closes 101bdd62, 4c79298d and 6c27657f in seconds. So for these three a verified derivation exists and rediscovery fails on retrieval plus missing tags; the tags themselves stay OPEN until reviewed. A version of 4c79298d without MoreInIsAsymmetric timed out (unresolved, not a countermodel). Rejected candidates: (1) 4c79298d from GodIsOne 33b18ae7, SomeBeingMaximalInBeing fad8af3e and MaximeEnsIsGod 957a71fe: MaximeEnsIsGod is GOD_2 and the target GOD_4 with no bridge (semantic mismatch), and GodIsOne's routes c719249b, bc0cff0b, 969ae822 use GodIsMaximalInBeing itself (support cycle); only d602ba9e is independent and the GOD_2/GOD_4 gap remains. (2) 4c79298d via 'whatever is more in being is simply prior' with God as first being: no statement supplies that bridge; it would be a new OPEN premise and is not proposed. (3) 6c27657f from a no-infinite-ascent premise in every respect (generalizing Round3FourthWay.NoInfiniteAscentInBeing) with MoreSuchHasThePerfection c11369aa: valid but adds a new OPEN premise and duplicates the at-esse route; not registered. (4) The lean-auto closures of f8ba2429 (inconsistent core of the recorded rivals 3143560d and 64498e7e) and 1ec205ed (known argument 529e5318, GOD_1/2/4 mixing): filtered noise.
blocker: Next tests: (1) author and review whole-binder sense tags for the carriers Being/B/Entity and Respect/R (no Respect sense record exists, #1823 follow-up) and for Aristotle's Has (IN_ACT_4?), then rerun the baseline; the diagnosis predicts that 101bdd62, 4c79298d and 6c27657f are then filtered as known. (2) Improve retrieval so that a candidate whose conclusion vocabulary matches a target's hypothesis (AsToBeingSoToTruth for 101bdd62) ranks within the budget; at 24 candidates it was still missed.
